issue_context.title: Run`make ut` error, too many open files
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement


## Problem1

make ut

```
building task finish, count=4783, takes=36.943982531s
run all tasks takes 2m38.904517081s
open temp cover file error: open /tmp/cov1281420580/executor.TestQueryTime: too many open files
make: *** [Makefile:131: gotest_in_verify_ci] Error 1
```

`ulimit -n`  result is 1024, but there are 4000+ temporary files...

## Problem2

After running `make ut`, too many *.test.bin file left, takes more than 5G disk size:

```
find . -name "*.bin" | xargs ls -l | awk '{ total += $5 }; END { print "total size: ",total }'
total size:  5943474416
```

review_comments: The old code `defer` in a for-loop, so the file is not closed immediately.
